visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Closure instead of a global
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The counter keeps its number in a global variable that any code can change. Hide it inside a function with a closure. The result shown must stay the same.

solution.explanation: With a closure, the number can only be changed through the function. Nothing else on the page can reset it by accident, and the name clicks cannot clash with another script.
